svg.title: Tool return card: give the silhouette a dependable ground
svg.desc: Only object-ground fill changes #687464→#e7e3d8. The identical generated open-shears PNG and constant-RGB alpha-preserving silhouette filter remain fixed. Blade/handle separation, fitting, orientation, size, placement, copy, typography and paper/light are identical. No moving parts, new silhouette geometry or recolored text. Source transparency including antialiased edges is retained. Original fictional example. Generated photographic sources; native silhouette composition and typography.
